plan.notes: Source: Prairie View A&M University 2026-2027 Catalog (https://catalog.pvamu.edu/academicprogramsanddegreeplans/coas/cam/engl-ba/), 'Bachelor of Arts in English - Without Teacher Certification Degree Sequence' degree sequence. Retrieved 2026-10-07. CATALOG DISCREPANCY (documented, not resolved): the catalog page text declares 120 total hours, but the degree-sequence tables print per-table totals summing to 231. Seeded at 231 per the tables; every term total below reconciles with the printed term totals. The catalog repeats the following course(s) across terms, transcribed as published: ENGL 2322, ENGL 2323, ENGL 2327, ENGL 2328, ENGL 3305, ENGL 3315, ENGL 3322, ENGL 4322, ENGL 4343. Sequence: With Teacher Certification track.
